verdict.rationale: Paxos is API-first: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials auth with scoped Client ID/Secret enables machine-to-machine access with no UI. A dedicated Sandbox environment supports end-to-end integration testing, and REST, FIX, and WebSocket APIs plus polling and event-listing endpoints let automated jobs run without a human in the loop. Missing for 10: no CLI or explicit CI/CD guidance, no published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), some setup still lives in the Dashboard (webhook configuration and testing, the sandbox Fund button), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
